The '''Iron Dirk''' is a [[Weapons#Dagger|dagger weapon]] that can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|500}} after reaching floor 15 in [[The Mines]]. It is also a possible reward for the chest on floor 10 of the Mines if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Level lowered from 2 to 1 and sell price lowered from {{Price|100}} to {{Price|50}}. Added as a possible reward on floor 10 in the remixed Mines.}}
